children: Indonesia raised 11 trillion rupiah ($616.25 million) from an Islamic bond auction on Tuesday, higher than the indicative target of 10 trillion rupiah, its finance ministry said.
Total incoming bids stood at 26.89 trillion rupiah, higher than the 26.14 trillion at the previous auction on September 8.
